Which liner had the first swimming pool is disputed: the Adriatic (1907) had a small plunge pool inside her Turkish baths, while maritime historians call the Olympic's (1911) the first true swimming pool on an ocean liner. The body sentence now says both; the notes record the dispute (the answer, a swimming pool, is the same either way).
